bundle.longDescription: Select an audio interface and put it through a bench: everything the driver says about it, round-trip latency through a loopback cable, frequency and phase response and harmonic distortion from a log sweep, THD+N from a tone, noise floor, and which buffer sizes it runs cleanly at. CoreAudio, ASIO, WASAPI, WDM-KS, DirectSound, MME and ALSA.
